The '''Ashern strike team''' was a group that was put together in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] to infiltrate the [[Dlarit estate]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Aerin Dlarit]]. The strike team was comprised of [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]], [[Sixtus Quin]], three former [[Imperial Naval Special Forces]] agents, two [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]], four [[Zaltin Corporation]] refugees, and was led by [[Elscol Loro]].<ref name="bacta" />
